notes.title: Act II - Ability trees hotfix
notes.notes:
A small update fixing ability trees for the old and the new players.

[VERSION 0.101] ACT II
* Fix - ability trees interactivity issues during first game launch
* Fix - ability upgrades not getting cleared properly after progress reset
* Fix - all ammo/health drop chances are now afected by difficulty handicap on higher difficulties

notes.title: Early Access Release Date
notes.notes: Load your rocket launchers! Early Access and the First Act of Dreadhunter will be released on [b]October 18th, 2023[/b]!
